description.text: 1.Program Introduction：The program focuses on developing the basic theories, knowledge and skills in international economics and trade, learning the present situation of developmentof economy and trade in moderm China and world, and being familiar with the intermational trade law and regulations which makes graduates be capable ofsolving practical international trade issues.The internationalized as well as combined with Chinese reality curriculum is adopted in this program and case study is often used in teaching. The basicknowledge of economics, managements and international trade is taught in this program, which makes the graduates strong in theoretical analysis and practice.2.Main Courses：Micro-Economics, Macro-Economics, Econometrics, Brief of World Economy, Intermational Trade, International Trade Practice, International Economics and Trade Geography, International Buiness Documentation, Buiness English Listening and Speaking, International Finance Statistics3.Career and Internship：Graduates can engage in the international trade department, industrial and commercial enterprises, economic management departments or economic scientificresearch company.

duration.text: The International economics and trade at Ningbo University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Passport copy Two-inch ID photo Highest degree certificate and complete transcript

requirements.text: 1 Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport2 Under the age of 25, have graduated from high school (those who have not graduated at the time of application must provide a pre-graduation certificate, and must obtain a high school graduation certificate before admission at the latest).3 Good conduct, physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders affecting normal learning).4 Nationality requirements: In accordance with the provisions of the Ministry of Education Foreign Letter (2020) 12 document5 English-taught majors do not require applicants to have Chinese proficiency. If the mother tongue is not English, applicants need to provide proof of TOEFL/IELTS scores or other proof of English proficiency.
